messages:
karla_customer: Heads up — I'm getting a 403 when opening the project console for org 'acme-inc' -> project 'atlas-data'. Started after I logged in via Okta SSO this morning. Error in UI: "403 Permission Denied: missing project.view". Can someone help? I'm org owner according to Okta groups.

elaine_support: Sorry you're blocked — can you paste repro steps and the browser network response for the console call? Also, are you using the regular user SSO or a service principal?

karla_customer: Steps:
1) SSO login
2) Click org -> project 'atlas-data'
3) UI shows error overlay, console logs 403 on GET /v1/projects/atlas-data

curl request I tried:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/atlas-data
# response: {"error":"403","message":"Permission denied: project.view"}
```
I confirmed token has scopes [openid profile email] but I don't see project roles in token claims.

samir_prodeng: Is this Hosted or Dedicated? Any recent org role sync changes?

karla_customer: Hosted. No recent changes on our side. Okta SCIM last push at 2024-08-10T09:12:03Z per their admin console.

deploy-bot: idp-sync job completed for org acme-inc at 2024-08-10T09:12:14Z (status: success)

elaine_support: Thanks — possible repro: SCIM group -> project role mapping didn't push project-level role claims into the session token. Can you check if Okta group mapping is sending the 'redwood_roles' claim? Also, did you try a full logout and re-login (clear SSO session)?

karla_customer: Okta mapping shows groups ok, but claim name looks like 'roles' not 'redwood_roles'. Will ask IdP admin.

sec_oncall: If token claims are missing it's often because the IdP's OIDC token config trimmed custom claims on refresh. Quick mitigation: org owner can create a short-lived org API key and use that to access project console settings while we debug.

elaine_support: Also opening internal ticket to check if our auth proxy dropped custom claims during token exchange — adding logs: `authz: warn dropped_claims=[\"redwood_roles\"]` on request id r-9a4c.

samir_prodeng: Can you ask Okta admin to re-push SCIM groups and ensure the OIDC Id token has the 'redwood_roles' claim? If they can't, use the workaround to generate a project-level key or have another owner re-assign roles via CLI.

karla_customer: Okta admin did a full push and corrected claim mapping name to 'redwood_roles'. I logged out and back in — access restored. :white_check_mark: Thanks all. What should we do to avoid this in future?

elaine_support: We'll update our docs to include the exact claim name and add an alert if claims are missing. I'll follow up with a permanent fix if our proxy is dropping custom claims. Leaving this thread open until we confirm root cause.

samir_prodeng: I'll add a small health check to detect missing role claims on SSO login and emit an org-level alert so admins can act faster.

karla_customer: Great — appreciate the quick turnaround.
